notes: «سنة أربع ومائتين» is a date, not a name; «حدثنا أبي وعبد الله بن جعفر الحميري» are co-transmitters, the father by relation; «عن آبائه» names the forefathers only as a gap (rule 8), so it is the last link; the Imam Abu Abd Allah sits after «عن» inside the chain, so he stays a narrator (ruling 2)
